compiled_state.title: sg-based dangling-reference matcher + FP-rate gate (CF-8 / E7)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
As a maintainer, I want a structurally-accurate (ast-grep / sg) dangling-reference matcher with a measured false-positive rate so that enforcing dangling-references does not wedge legitimate promotions on comment/string false matches.

Plan refs: A-4 (CF-8); the matcher is git-grep today (check-dangling-references.sh:20-21 — confirmed greenfield). E7 is BLOCKING for the enforce-flip. THIS IS THE EPIC'S ONE GENUINE REBUILD-RISK — front-loaded so we learn the answer fast.

DONE DEFINITION:
- DD1: sg-based reference matcher (guarded git-grep fallback when sg absent), reference-side scans .md/.yml/Makefile/.txt, short-symbol guard. (SC1)
- DD2: a 20-PR ground-truth set is assembled and the matcher's FP/FN rate measured against it. (SC1)
- DD3: GO/NO-GO recorded: FP rate 0 (or acceptable) -> dangling-references is enforce-ready; OTHERWISE the documented FALLBACK applies (ship review-gate with coverage-invariant ENFORCED and dangling-references ADVISORY) and the epic proceeds with reduced scope, not blocked.
- DD4: TDD for the matcher + the fallback wiring.

LIVE VERIFICATION + EXPERIMENTS:
- E7: run the matcher over the 20-PR ground-truth set; record FP/FN. Also confirm its exit-78 enforce path blocks (mirror of story 1, V0.4).

COURSE-CORRECTION TRIGGER (the key fast-feedback gate): if sg cannot reach an acceptable FP rate, DO NOT block the epic — invoke the fallback (dangling advisory) and record the decision in ADR-0020. This story exists to surface that fork EARLY, before story 5/7 assume an enforce-ready dangling check.

Maps to SC1. Independent of stories 1/2/3; pull early.

comments.body: Implemented on branch story/588e-abec-221f-42c0/29e7-c612-706d-42bc @ 5f2b0b48. sg/ast-grep matcher + guarded git-grep fallback in check-dangling-references.sh (IO/exit contract unchanged). MEASURED on 13-case fixture set: sg path FP=0/8 FN=0/5; git-grep fallback FP=50%. Recommendation: GO (enforce-ready) CONDITIONAL on the live 20-PR E7 run. Harness measure-dangling-fp-fn.sh + fixtures added. LEFT FOR LIVE: assemble + run the 20-PR ground-truth set in warn before enforce-flip.

CLOSING TASK (the 6 llm-review findings blocking PR #631's review-sub-pr; folded here from the resilience-hardening story per panel topology -- land on the EXISTING #631 branch to complete this story). Fix plugins/dso/scripts/ci/check-dangling-references.sh + harnesses. DEFAULT to FAIL-CLOSED: a "skip the symbol" branch is itself a false-negative path, so skip only with a logged reason, else INDETERMINATE/error. (Line refs approximate -- file shifted since #631; resolve each PR #631 review comment when addressed.)
1. _materialize_head_file (~:143-151): the git-show exit-code skip is ALREADY present (candidates come from `git grep -lw $sym $HEAD`, so the file exists at HEAD) -- HARDEN the `>` redirect ordering AND add the missing exit-code check on the sg invocation at ~:172 (`run -p ... 2>/dev/null` currently swallows parse failures -> silent empty -> false negative).
2. _defined_at_head shell-def regex (~:128) + def-exclusion filters (~:175 sg, ~:182 grep): require `{` after `()` so `${sym}()` stops matching real Python 0-arg calls (false negatives); keep the Python def/class exclusion.
3. _doc_references (~:189): the live tree ALREADY has -w (`git grep -nwF`) -- verify against the PR-631 baseline; if present, this finding is MOOT (no change).
4. DSO_DANGLING_MIN_LEN (~:53 + use ~:198): validate numeric before bash arithmetic (reject non-numeric env input).
5. sg detection (~:67): align with centrality.sh:18-26's stricter `sg --version | grep -qE '^(sg|ast-grep) [0-9]'`.
6. Harnesses (test-dangling-references-sg-matcher.sh, tests/scripts/measure-dangling-fp-fn.sh): isolate the git env (HOME/GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL); check git-op exit codes in _build_repo. RED tests reproduce the regex false-negative AND the sg-invocation silent-empty before the fix (GREEN after).
